title: Watch and answer
instruction: Watch a developer explain why a portfolio project matters. Identify his advice, then choose a project you could explain

video.title: How to Get a Developer Job — freeCodeCamp.org

items.prompt: Who is this advice mainly for?
items.hint: Listen for the stage of the person’s career
items.answer: It is mainly for someone looking for their first programming job

items.prompt: Why can a portfolio project help when you have no previous programming job?
items.hint: Think about what the project shows instead of work experience
items.answer: It can show what you can do when you have no previous work experience

items.prompt: What does the speaker ask you to choose now?
items.hint: Listen for how many projects should be the main focus
items.answer: He asks you to choose one main portfolio project

items.prompt: Which project would you choose to show someone, and why?
items.hint: Choose something you can demonstrate and explain
items.answer: Example: I’d choose my task-list app because I can explain what it does and show one feature working
